content.text: Section 11 fully addresses the rule at the preferred position.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in all material respects: 11.1 gives up to six months' transition assistance on Customer's request at the expiring Order Form rates (better than "then-current rates" for us), 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented machine-readable format and bars withholding data over a fee dispute, and 11.3 requires secure deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, with written officer certification and continuing protection of any legally retained copy. Sections 10.1-10.2 reinforce this with continuing rights in Customer Data, Deliverable delivery, and refunds of prepaid Fees. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no denial of data return). No redline needed.
